recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio portrait of a woman with voluminous spiky black hair, wearing a black halter dress and sheer pink neck scarf, set against a clean white background with a gradient header and vibrant neon script typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The magenta script echoes the color of the subject's scarf and makeup.
The spiky silhouette of the hair contrasts with the fluid, rounded letterforms.
The subject's gaze and hand gesture lead the eye toward the central torso and then up to the branding.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, waist-up, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and spiky hair serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down the scarf to the hand, then sweeps up the right side following the diagonal script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample white space on the left and right sides creates a clean, airy feel despite the bold subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White (background) and Black (clothing/hair) provide the structural foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Magenta/Hot Pink provides the primary pop of color in text and accessories.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft lavender and blue gradients appear in the top border.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the pinks against a neutral, high-value background.

letterConstructionRules: Letters are connected in a fluid, cursive style
Heavy black drop shadow or outline to create depth
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'J' and 'C' are oversized and highly stylized with circular loops
The dot on the 'i' is integrated into the flow of the stroke

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed within the top gradient bar

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Vibrant, expressive script paired with a rigid, understated condensed sans-serif for balance.
graphicDevices: Top horizontal gradient bar (blue to pink)

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, rounded, monolinear script feel.
Matches the thin, tall, spaced-out metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a woman with 80s-style spiky black hair, wearing a black halter dress and a sheer pink scarf. The background is solid white. Include a thin horizontal bar at the very top with a soft blue-to-pink gradient.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large magenta script text in the top right, tilted at a 30-degree angle with a hard black drop shadow. Add small, widely-spaced black condensed sans-serif text centered in the top gradient bar.

verificationChecks: Is the script text magenta with a black shadow?
Is the hair silhouette spiky and voluminous?
Is the top gradient bar present?

adjustableVariables: Width of the top gradient bar
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Smooth, vector-like quality to the script

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the script does not obscure the subject's face.
Check that the magenta color is consistent across text and accessories.
Verify the high-key lighting doesn't wash out the skin tones.
Confirm the top gradient bar is subtle and doesn't dominate.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + high-key white background + spiky black hair + magenta script with black shadow + top gradient bar.
